;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**Five [[Pakistan Armed Forces|Pakistani soldiers]] are killed and one is injured by a bomb blast in [[Jammu and Kashmir (state)|Jammu and Kashmir]]. [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/defence/pakistan-accuses-india-of-killing-five-soldiers-in-kashmir/articleshow/70061044.cms (''Economic Times'')]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**A [[mass grave]] containing over 200 bodies is discovered in [[Raqqa]], [[Syria]]. The victims, who were shackled and shot in the head, are believed to have been killed by [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] militants. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/07/mass-grave-200-bodies-uncovered-raqqa-190703141719474.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Over one million people in the [[Prefectures of Japan|Japanese prefectures]] of [[Miyazaki Prefecture|Miyazaki]] and [[Kagoshima Prefecture|Kagoshima]] are ordered to evacuate their homes due to torrential rainfall. An elderly woman in Kagoshima city died after a mudslide hit her home. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48850111 (BBC News)]
*One tourist is killed and several injured when [[Mt. Stromboli]] in [[Italy]] erupts. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48857422 (BBC News)]
*At least 26 people have died after a fishing boat capsized off the coast of [[Honduras]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-48863406 (BBC News)]
*At least six people are killed and 190 injured after a tornado hits the city of [[Kaiyuan, Liaoning|Kaiyuan]] in [[Liaoning Province]], China. [https://globalnews.ca/news/5459008/tornado-northeast-china/ (Global News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Otto Warmbier|Death of Otto Warmbier]], [[North Korea–United States relations]]
**The parents of Otto Warmbier, an American student who died in North Korean custody after allegedly being tortured, file a claim for a seized North Korean cargo ship in an attempt to collect on a $501 million judgment they received after suing the country. [https://www.wnem.com/seized-north-korean-ship-sought-for-american-student-otto-warmbier/article_7cc6d4c8-b313-5326-b1f1-e53fc132cdc9.html (Associated Press)]
